data-blora-thread.description: Marks a thread root for comment reactions, automatic long-content folding and composer tabs

data-blora-thread-comment.description: Marks a forum comment card; .blora-thread-comment is also accepted

data-blora-thread-tab.description: Composer tab (data-tab="edit"|"preview"); toggles data-active and the composer's data-tab state

data-blora-thread-command.description: Composer Markdown command: bold, italic, code, link, quote or mention; applies to the nearest .blora-thread-composer__input selection

data-collapse-height.description: Per-comment collapsed body height in pixels; defaults to controller option collapseHeight (158)

data-collapsible.description: Controller-written when the comment body exceeds the collapsed height

data-active.description: Active state for a reaction button or composer tab

data-label-expand.description: Per-comment expand label (default 展开评论)

data-label-collapse.description: Per-comment collapse label (default 收起评论)

createThreadController.description: Create a comment-stream controller: auto-detect and fold long comment bodies, toggle reactions, and switch composer tabs
